question: I'm a huge fan of the Sword Demon Love Song manga adaptation. The artwork is amazing! I'd love to see something similar for EX5. What do you think?
answer:
Of course I'd love to see it...!

Seeing my own work adapted into manga, film, or games—and seeing expressions and interpretations that didn't originate from me—is incredibly stimulating.

If they end up being more entertaining than what I came up with, I'll be thinking, “Damn it!” (laughs)
